name: shopbuddy
description: ShopBuddy — friendly voice-first AI shopping buddy (Agora Conversational AI + Murf Falcon TTS)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && cd client && npx tsc -b && echo typecheck OK
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:live
